summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion identifies a two-lane universe for the AI data-center power-chain node. Reference lane: Vertiv remains the obvious high-attention benchmark for complete power, cooling and modular AI-factory infrastructure. Underfollowed/discovery lane: Powell Industries, IES Holdings and nVent have more direct chokepoint exposure than their generic industrial labels imply: medium-voltage switchgear and behind-the-meter data-center electrical systems; communications/electrical infrastructure and custom engineered solutions for data centers; and liquid-cooling plus rack-level power distribution. The strongest near-term evidence is Powell's disclosed >$400M data-center order and IES's reported data-center-driven segment growth. nVent is included as a large-cap but unusually pure second-order liquid-cooling/power component platform. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Layer 1B expansion focused on scarce suppliers and execution bottlenecks around AI data-center electrical power, thermal management, and construction labor. The universe should not stop at mega-cap electrical leaders; the more Serenity-relevant discovery lane includes mid-cap vendors with direct evidence of data-center orders, backlog growth, or hyperscale/colocation customer exposure. Four candidates were retained: one reference leader for context and three underfollowed or less-obvious public-market mappings tied to switchgear, cooling, and electrical/data-center construction.
